p.src: 1  I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

en: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
u.src: 1  I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

p.src: 2  He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

en: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
u.src: 2  He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

p.src: 3  He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

en: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
u.src: 3  He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

p.src: 4  When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

ja: き記そうとした。すると、
en: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”
u.src: 4  When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

p.src: 5  The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

ja: っているのを私が見た御
en: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky
u.src: 5  The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

p.src: 6  and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

ja: った。「もはや猶予はない。
en: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
u.src: 6  and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

p.src: 7  but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

ja: こうとするとき、その音が響けば、
en: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.
u.src: 7  but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

p.src: 8  The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

en: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”
u.src: 8  The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

p.src: 9  I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

ja: を渡してほしいと頼んだ。 御使いは
べなさい。それはあなたの
en: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
u.src: 9  I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

p.src: 10  I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

en: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
u.src: 10  I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

p.src: 11  They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

ja: たちについて、もう一度
en: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
